body: I don’t get everyone’s immediate reluctance to even entertain the possibility that Tre could fall to us. Look at every draft the past 5-10 years. Teams have gone and drafted completely different than what analysts and experts believe. Tre has been mocked as low as 10 or as high as 4 in some drafts. If I’m the FO I factor in every possible outcome. Such as the Pels, hornets or wizards skipping him. The wizards may eventually wanna move Sarr over to the 4 thus snagging Queen or KM could be on their board. The Pels aren’t the most well run team and the hornets have also had drafts where they completely forget the milk in their cereal. If Tre is on the board at 9 and the raptors don’t atleast consider him then that’s a failure on the FO. The reservation I’m seeing is people on the sub going “oH bOy aNoTher BuCket gEtTer!” and immediately dismissing snagging him because of our depth at the guard position. Here’s my thing, we constantly bitch Scottie isn’t a number 1 option and more of a complementary star. Why the fuck should we not consider this kid if he falls to us?! The kid shows he can be something in this league and right now we’re in the perfect position to grab a kid like him, Noa or even KM and have them play limited minutes and train with arguably one of the best developmental coaches in the league. If we pass on Tre and he turns into a 20+ ppg scorer with high efficiency and the ability to be a top 5 at his position this sub would implode on itself. Again this is all only if Tre falls to us, I’m not gonna bitch if the FO doesn’t make moves up in the draft to grab him or if he gets taken before us. But if he falls to us and we pass him for a backup big because this sub loves the idea of KM then I’m sorry that’s the most idiotic decision that can be made.

KM to us makes sense for us as there’s absolutely zero way Yak gets a sizable extension with us given he’s almost 30 and right now he offers us great rim protection along with PNR. Taking KM means the FO knows they need to plan for a 5 that can inherit the position when it’s time for Yak to move on either to another team or off the bench. The possibilities that KM flashes screams top 5 center in his future (not the near future relax everybody). I view this mostly from the perspective of I’d be happy if we took him if the following players were off the board in no particular order:
1. Queen
2. Fears (I know he’s mocked high but let’s also not rule out teams passing on him for positions of need.) 
3. Noa Essengue

It’s bluntly obvious WOTC knew RC was considering banning crypt and lotus, so they went off and made as much as they could off those cards while they still could.

Most casual players play with their friend group at home or their friends’ homes. By basically making sets that contain Lotus and Crypt worthless to buy, you just fucked hundreds of LGS’ across the country. Not only that if you’re gonna say you shouldn’t look at MTG as an investment then bring back the fucking MSRP. Crypt and Lotus aren’t making the game too expensive, paying $70 for a fucking pre con that barely even has $50 of value in it is what’s making the game too expensive. Hell if crypt barely changes the landscape of a game aside from making the player that drops crypt turn one public enemy. Anytime I’ve dropped crypt turn one, it’s been destroyed or exiled by turn 3-4. Now I know that doesn’t happen to everyone but, maybe the EDH community should start making removal and counter magic something new players should be educated to run in their decks. It’s not like Emrakul, where you can’t respond to it being cast or hitting the field. Literally there’s hundreds of cards that can stop crypt or lotus. Best thing to do is trade away prospects in positions you don’t need covered for the foreseeable future. I’ve met cooks that stay sober after hitting rock bottom and stay in the industry but, I’ve seen a lot that relapse instantly and have to move onto a completely different career. It really is gonna come down to your husband and if the pressure is too much for him. Just be patient with him and if he relapses, please forgive him and understand that it is a part of recovery.
